doesNotClaimR2: There is no `reviews[]` entry here and there will not be one from me. R2 wants a named reviewer who is not the author, and I am the author of every path above. This migration touches finance-adjacent personal data (recorded spend with recorder stamps) on a surface that holds children's data, so under the team rule it goes to the CTO, and there is no independent security reviewer on this team (board declined the seat on cost) -- a CTO self-review is a recorded degradation, not independent review. The commit carrying these compliance-path files WILL report an R2 violation until that review records its verdict, and that violation is the honest state. The compliance paths stay uncommitted until the CTO verdict lands on the AFC-801 issue. Writing a `reviews[]` entry naming myself would turn a control into a rubber stamp.

whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: AFC-801 (parent AFC-756): per-event expense records. Migration 20261025_0044 creates event_expenses (uuid PK; event NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; branch/zone denorms SET NULL; 8-category CHECK with strict other-label pairing; amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK >= 0; currency DEFAULT NGN with no CHECK; spent_on date NOT NULL; receipt bare uuid with conditional directus_files FK SET NULL; notes; recorded_by; created_at; no updated_at) with bootstrap-role guard per 0001/0042, ownership precondition over events/branches/zones per the 0042 pattern, and no roles provisioned (ADR-0002). No DB scope trigger by choice 8: the portal route stamps branch/zone at create (0021 registrations.post precedent), keeping the versioned suite-94 pin (28 triggers) untouched. Grants: SELECT plus column-scoped INSERT (all but id/created_at) and UPDATE (operational only: category, label, amount, currency, spent_on, receipt, notes) to directus_app; NO DELETE anywhere; PUBLIC revoked. The down script refuses with restrict_violation while any row exists, then drops with no cascading drop. Suite 44 covers shape, enum pairing, RESTRICT (23503) plus confdeltype pins, the app ceiling (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE allowed; audit-ground-truth UPDATE and DELETE 42501), rerun idempotence, empty rollback plus forward re-apply, and zero-orphan acceptance. Numbering: 0044, because 20261025_0043_department_guides.sql (AFC-800, same day) already holds 0043 for a different register; the CTO resolves the collision record on the AFC-801 issue.
